duration.text: The English at Shandong University of Traditional Chinese Medicine is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese/English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3194 USD/per year ￥ 23000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant High school academic transcript High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: Application requirement High school, or with the same level or above level In good health If you are a good master of Chinese (HSK 5 and above), you can directly attend "ordinary class" where lessons are given in Chinese. If there are many people who can not speak Chinese but English, a "special class" where lessons will be given in English.
